# Narrow Slots, Plain Words

Version 1.9.4 lets the card fit into narrower sections slots and reads free-text opening hours more carefully, so the badge no longer announces the wrong opening time and one broken entry no longer hides the whole card.

## Layout

- **The card fits into a 4-column slot.** In a sections dashboard the card could not be made narrower than 6 columns, half a section. It now goes down to 4. Above roughly 200px nothing changes. Below that the opening-hours badge may wrap instead of running out of the card, and below roughly 150px the name and badge move under the logo and the price tiles put their label above the price instead of next to it _[#124]_.

## Opening hours

- **Common German day words are read correctly.** `Mo - Fr` with spaces around the dash was read as Monday and Friday only, and `werktags` was not understood and applied to every day. The card now reads `Mo - Fr` as Monday to Friday, `werktags` as Monday to Saturday and `täglich` as every day. A station with `werktags 06:00-22:00; So 08:00-20:00` showed "Opens at 6:00 AM" early on a Sunday; it now shows 8:00 AM _[#126]_.
- **Hours the card only half understands no longer turn into a guess.** `täglich außer So` was read as Sunday only, the opposite of what it says. When a rule mixes known days with a word the card cannot read, the rule now applies to no day, and the badge falls back to plain Open or Closed. Text without any known day, such as `Immer`, still applies to every day, as before _[#126]_.
- **One opening-time entry without times no longer blanks the card.** If a station reported an entry with a day but no start or end time, the card failed to render, and every station on it disappeared. That entry is now skipped and the rest of the hours show as usual _[#126]_.

Nothing to change after updating. If you gave the card 6 columns only because it could not be made narrower, you can now resize it.
